scope: Exact shared Citadel 2.6.0 artifact5633260 animation lifecycle, not a new creature implementation

inspection.method: Pure-Python class constant-pool and bytecode decoding; all selected method bodies inspected. No Java/JAR execution. Unsupported variable-width opcodes raise rather than guess.
inspection.not_claimed: Remaining ClientProxy/ServerProxy method bodies, whole network registration, renderer/terrain implementation

observations.subject: AnimationHandler.sendAnimationMessage
observations.result: Server-side path calls entity.setAnimation then broadcasts runtime entity ID and array index. No tick reset in this helper; actual entity setter remains relevant.

observations.subject: AnimationHandler.updateAnimations
observations.result: At tick0 Start event is posted. Canceled Start skips send only; local advance continues. Tick advances only while tick<duration; equality resets tick0 and NO_ANIMATION. tick>duration has no own recovery branch. This is conditional control-flow evidence, not a demonstrated Dynasty defect.

observations.subject: Completion and cleanup
observations.result: Null animation path assigns NO_ANIMATION; NO_ANIMATION path does not clear a stray tick. Helper contains no posture flag, navigation, paired participant, persistence or end-pose cleanup. Entity/goal code must be inspected separately.

observations.subject: ModelAnimator lifecycle
observations.result: update clears both transform maps and timing state; setAnimation compares object identity and resets timing counters, not maps. rotate/move accumulate transforms. Static frames hold previous transforms. Non-static frames blend previous and current with sin(progress*pi/2); resetKeyframe toward empty map restores additive baseline, not entity flags.

observations.subject: Keyframe sampling
observations.result: Integer tick window is start-inclusive/end-exclusive; partial time is0 when paused, otherwise getFrameTime. Map rollover happens after each non-static frame regardless of active sampling window. Duration/keyframe-sum mismatch can leave a non-contributing tail; default pose and overlays are separate.

observations.subject: Client packet apply
observations.result: Current-level entity lookup then IAnimatedEntity cast. Index-1 selects NO_ANIMATION; otherwise array lookup. Tick reset to0 occurs after setAnimation. Missing actor has no own retry; no bounds guard in selected method. ServerProxy selected handler is empty. No threading/network safety conclusion without registration context.

observations.subject: Animation/Event/Transform
observations.result: Animation stores duration and ID; NO_ANIMATION uses duration0. Start event can replace event animation. Tick event receives new tick. Transform offsets/rotations add without clamping. Packet payload is two ints, not a pose snapshot.
